code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    period = max(max(row) for row in grid)
    start = grid[1][0]
    def seq(index):
        return ((start - 1 + index) % period) + 1
    for r, row in enumerate(out):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value == 0:
                if r == 0:
                    row[c] = start - 1 if c == 0 else seq(c - 1)
                else:
                    row[c] = seq(c if c < r else c - 1)
    return out
'''
